response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong alignment with the Staff Software Engineer role, particularly in distributed systems, AI-driven development, and technical strategy. His current work at re:cinq on AI-agent infrastructure and full-stack engineering, combined with his operational experience and stakeholder collaboration, makes him a compelling candidate. While his background is slightly broader than the ideal profile, his hands-on work with agentic systems and high-throughput architectures addresses core requirements.
strengths: Direct experience with AI-driven engineering (MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq)
Proven expertise in high-throughput, distributed systems (Dunnhumby, Altom Consulting)
Strong operational ownership and agile methodology experience (on-call, CI/CD, incident response)
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Python expertise (a must-have skill)
Breadth of experience may dilute depth in AI-native engineering environments
No clear evidence of prior staff-level technical strategy leadership
